issues.description: The problem specification (UML and instructions) requires a static method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal): int, but the provided code (both the commented Main in the template and the reference solution) implements and calls a static method named computeMealCost(Meal). This name mismatch between the specification and the code will confuse students: they may implement calculateTotalPrice as instructed, while the supplied Main/solution expect computeMealCost, causing compilation errors or unexpected test failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across all artifacts. Either rename the method in the solution and all template references from computeMealCost to calculateTotalPrice (and update comments/usage accordingly), or update the problem statement and UML to require computeMealCost instead of calculateTotalPrice. Ensure Main and tests use the same method name as specified in the problem.
